raw_need: Review and consolidate QIF v0.2.1 after schema and verifier hardening.
validated_need: QIF v0.2.1 needs a review-only consolidation before v0.3 pilot so its entities, responsibilities, runtime flow, verifier boundary, package architecture, names, and cleanup tasks are coherent and explainable.
decision_summary: Validated as a consolidation/review project, not a redesign or feature expansion.

validation_questions_answered.question: What is in scope?
validation_questions_answered.answer: Review existing v0.2.1 docs, schemas, examples, verifier behavior, changelog, and AOF evidence.

validation_questions_answered.question: What proves success?
validation_questions_answered.answer: A consolidation report with all requested deliverables plus passing npm test and AOF council review.

hidden_assumptions: Schema/verifier hardening alone was assumed to be enough for pilot readiness.
evidence_gaps: Semantic validity of QIF still requires pilot use and expert review; this review only assesses conceptual and structural readiness.
